answer_1.quote: We study recently proposed referencefree evaluation metrics of text summarization and dialog generation.

answer_2.quote: We compare the metrics to spurious correlates such as word‑overlap, length and perplexity, in order to understand whether the metrics can perform better than these simple measures.

answer_4.quote: We use the large‑scale faithfulness human annotations collected by ... for 16 summarization models on the CNN/DM dataset.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to judge the faithfulness/entailment of generated summaries and dialogue responses.
